_notes: UQM 0.8.0's own lander among creatures, recorded as lander.json is, with the life nodes put on the surface as GeneratePlanetSide and generateBioNode put them (TFB_Random's draws for the moving ones' places and every creature's first frame come first) and contact found by UQM's own DrawablesIntersect with the masks of graphics.lander, graphics.miscdata, graphics.lifecan and graphics.life.0 to 25 from the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef). Positions and events come from code and the masks' shapes; no content.

Landings on worlds with creatures and no energy nodes, chosen so every ordinary kind (0 to 22) is on one, with their mineral nodes too, landing on the first creature's node and firing, with upgrades by turn; and among the most dangerous kinds with 4 crew, without and with the biological shield (8).

input as in lander-pickups.json, nodes [scan (0 mineral, 2 life), type, density, x, y]. frames as in lander.json; a creature's element is [x, y, scan_node, playerNr, hit_points, mass_points (its kind, | 128 when aware; its value once canned), sheet (9 canister, 10 + n graphics.life.n), frame, thrust_wait, flashing].
